rogue_talent.name: Bleeding Attack
rogue_talent.description: Sneak attacks cause bleed damage equal to sneak attack dice.

rogue_talent.name: Fast Stealth
rogue_talent.description: Move at full speed while using Stealth.

rogue_talent.name: Finesse Rogue
rogue_talent.description: Gain Weapon Finesse as a bonus feat.

rogue_talent.name: Ledge Walker
rogue_talent.description: Move along narrow surfaces at full speed; not flat-footed while doing so.

rogue_talent.name: Minor Magic
rogue_talent.description: Cast one 0-level sorcerer/wizard spell 3/day as a SLA.

rogue_talent.name: Quick Disable
rogue_talent.description: Disable traps in half the normal time (minimum 1 round).

rogue_talent.name: Resiliency
rogue_talent.description: Once per day, gain temp HP equal to rogue level when brought below 0 HP.

rogue_talent.name: Rogue Vigor
rogue_talent.description: Gain fast healing 1 for 1 round after a sneak attack.

rogue_talent.name: Slow Reactions
rogue_talent.description: Targets you sneak attack can’t make attacks of opportunity for 1 round.

rogue_talent.name: Stand Up
rogue_talent.description: Stand from prone as a free action (still provokes).

rogue_talent.name: Surprise Attack
rogue_talent.description: Opponents are flat-footed to you during the surprise round.

rogue_talent.name: Trap Spotter
rogue_talent.description: Automatically get a Perception check within 10 ft. of a trap.

rogue_talent.name: Weapon Training
rogue_talent.description: Gain Weapon Focus as a bonus feat.

advanced_rogue_talent.name: Crippling Strike
advanced_rogue_talent.description: Sneak attacks also deal 2 Strength damage.

advanced_rogue_talent.name: Defensive Roll
advanced_rogue_talent.description: Once/day make a Reflex save to take half damage from a lethal blow.

advanced_rogue_talent.name: Improved Evasion
advanced_rogue_talent.description: Take half damage on failed Reflex saves; none on success.

advanced_rogue_talent.name: Major Magic
advanced_rogue_talent.description: Cast one 1st-level sorcerer/wizard spell 2/day as a SLA.

advanced_rogue_talent.name: Opportunist
advanced_rogue_talent.description: Once/round make an attack of opportunity against a foe just struck in melee.

advanced_rogue_talent.name: Skill Mastery
advanced_rogue_talent.description: Select skills; can take 10 even when stressed.

advanced_rogue_talent.name: Slippery Mind
advanced_rogue_talent.description: Retry a failed save vs. enchantment 1 round later.

paladin_mercy.description: Lay on hands also acts as remove disease.

paladin_mercy.name: Poisoned
paladin_mercy.description: Lay on hands also acts as neutralize poison.
